# Okpala Chimaobi Samuel (Kremz)

> Okpala Chimaobi Samuel, known as Kremz, Elon Kremz or ElonKremz, is a Nigerian software developer and technology entrepreneur. He is a co-founder of ADITH (Advancing Digital Innovation Through Human), co-founder and CEO of Sephry Tech (formerly Codex Tech Foundation) and creator of the Zerøbyte product ecosystem. He is from Anambra State, based in Nigeria, and studies Computer Science at Caritas University, Enugu State.

## Key facts
- ADITH (Advancing Digital Innovation Through Human) is the parent company of Sephry Tech, Sterling Technologies and Rizzbase. It was founded by Okpala Samuel, Samuel Amos Ekpo and Paul Adamu. Samuel Amos Ekpo is CEO of Sterling Technologies, and Paul Adamu is founder of Rizzbase.
- Sephry Tech was founded by Okpala Samuel, Ochibe Favour and Nzekwe Chinaza Mary Jane.
- In development: Gradeva (school management system for small private schools in Nigeria), Oga Landlord (management system for landlords), Campus (social networking app for campus students).
- Zerøbyte is an independent product ecosystem: ID, Cloud, Social, Business, Copilot and Vault (.zbb Zerøbyte Backup Bundle backups).
- Zerøbyte Business is a business management SaaS for Nigerian SMEs, launching late November or early December 2026.
